explanation: T1-T5,T7-T9 are chemically valid heavy-atom rotatable bonds.
T6 maps to curated CCD C3=O carboxamide carbonyl and is an inappropriate active torsion.
T10 maps to terminal hydroxyethyl C21-O1; Meeko models OH rotation, while RDKit Strict excludes terminal bonds.
Thus 8 RDKit Strict + 1 terminal OH definition difference + 1 chemically inappropriate carbonyl = 10 Meeko/AutoDock torsions.
